# re2 AT&T testregex-style format
# type\tpattern\tstring\texpected

# Extended patterns
E	[a-z]+	hello	(0,5)
E	^foo$	foo	(0,3)
E	(a|b)c	ac	(0,2)(0,1)

# Basic patterns
B	[0-9]\+	123	(0,3)
B	^line$	line	(0,4)

# Literal
L	foo.bar	foo.bar	(0,7)

# Error patterns (should be extracted but may be unencodable)
E	*invalid	NOMATCH

# Comment lines (skip)
# This is a comment

# Directive lines (skip)
: sym

# Empty line (skip)

# Pattern with special chars
E	\(parens\)	(parens)	(0,8)
E	a{2,4}	aaaa	(0,4)
